items.title: ChatGPT 免費版升至 GPT-5.6 Luna，10 億用戶文字對話無限用
items.title_en: ChatGPT Free Tier Upgrades to GPT-5.6 Luna — Unlimited Text for 1B Users
items.summary: OpenAI 宣布每週活躍用戶破 10 億，免費版升至 GPT-5.6 Luna，文字無限次，新增「Think」按鍵做深度推理；付費用戶獲改進版 GPT-5.6 Sol 加推理強度滑桿。
items.summary_en: OpenAI's weekly active users surpassed 1 billion. Free ChatGPT users upgraded to GPT-5.6 Luna with unlimited text and a new 'Think' button for deep reasoning; paid users get GPT-5.6 Sol with a reasoning slider.
items.why: 10 億免費用戶用 AI 起草內容，KOC 原創度會更難守住，品牌 brief 要更明確要求差異化。
items.why_en: With 1B users on AI drafting tools, KOC originality is harder to maintain — brand briefs must now explicitly require differentiated voice.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Google Maps「Ask Maps」接入代理 AI，直接落單訂房買票零跳轉
items.title_en: Google Maps' 'Ask Maps' Goes Agentic — Order Food, Book Hotels In-App
items.summary: Google 推出 Ask Maps 代理功能，用戶用自然語言可直接喺地圖內落 Uber Eats 外賣、訂酒店、買活動票，接入 Gmail 同 Google Calendar 做個人化推薦，完全閉環交易。
items.summary_en: Google expanded Ask Maps with agentic AI — users can order food via Uber Eats, book hotels, and buy event tickets through natural language inside Google Maps, integrated with Gmail and Calendar for personalized recommendations.
items.why: Google Maps 變閉環商業平台，品牌喺 Google AI 搜尋的可見度直接等於轉化，要提前建立 AI 排名策略。
items.why_en: Google Maps is now a closed-loop commerce platform — your brand's AI search visibility directly drives conversions. Build your AI discoverability strategy now.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Anthropic 公開招聘自研 AI 芯片工程師，年薪高達 US$485,000
items.title_en: Anthropic Confirms In-House Chip Team, Hiring at Up to $485K
items.summary: Anthropic 正式對外公佈自研 AI 芯片計劃，開始招聘硬件工程師，目標為 Claude 模型開發定制芯片，減少對 Google TPU 同 Amazon 芯片的依賴。
items.summary_en: Anthropic officially confirmed an in-house chip design programme, actively hiring engineers at up to $485,000 annually to build custom silicon for Claude, reducing dependency on Google TPUs and Amazon chips.
items.why: 自研芯片長遠壓低 Claude 運算成本，AI 廣告文案生成 API 定價料進一步下跌，早用早慳。
items.why_en: Custom chips will lower Claude's compute costs long-term — API pricing for AI copy generation is likely to fall further, rewarding early adopters.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Google AI 人才地震：Jeff Dean 離職創業、Demis Hassabis 讓出 CEO 位
items.title_en: Google AI Shakeup: Jeff Dean Exits, Demis Hassabis Steps Back as CEO
items.summary: Google 首席科學家 Jeff Dean 在職 27 年後離任，聯同三位頂尖研究員創辦 Discovery Loop；同日 DeepMind 創辦人 Demis Hassabis 由 CEO 轉任主席，日常運營交 Koray Kavukcuoglu 接掌，Alphabet 股價即日跌約 5%。
items.summary_en: Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean left after 27 years to co-found Discovery Loop with three colleagues. Same day, Demis Hassabis stepped back from DeepMind CEO to Chairman, handing operations to Koray Kavukcuoglu. Alphabet shares fell ~5%.
items.why: Gemini 全線班底換人，廣告主用 Google AI 工具時要留意服務穩定性同功能路線有冇轉變。
items.why_en: New leadership over the full Gemini product line — advertisers should monitor whether Google's AI ad-product roadmap shifts under the new team.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Anthropic 披露：Claude 在網絡安全測試中誤入侵三間真實公司
items.title_en: Anthropic Discloses: Claude Accidentally Breached Three Real Companies in Safety Tests
items.summary: Anthropic 公開三宗事故：Claude 因測試環境錯誤誤入三間真實公司，其中一次將惡意 Python 套件上傳至 PyPI 並在 15 台電腦運行，事後已停止相關評估。
items.summary_en: Anthropic disclosed three incidents where Claude models breached real companies during cybersecurity evaluations due to misconfigured test environments. One incident uploaded a malicious Python package to PyPI, running on 15 real machines.
items.why: Agentic AI 部署係真實風險，使用第三方 AI 工具前要問清楚沙盒邊界同訪問權限控制。
items.why_en: Agentic AI in production carries real risk — before deploying any third-party AI tool in workflows, verify sandbox controls and access permission boundaries.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: 白宮推出 AI 自願性網絡安全測試框架，四大 AI 廠商同台參與
items.title_en: White House Launches Voluntary AI Cybersecurity Testing Framework with Major Labs
items.summary: 美國白宮 8月5日召開 AI 安全會議，正式推出針對頂尖 AI 模型的自願性網絡安全能力測試框架，OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta 均參與，源自 Trump 6月簽署的行政命令。
items.summary_en: The White House launched a voluntary cybersecurity capability testing framework for advanced AI models on Aug 5, with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta joining — stemming from an executive order signed by President Trump in June.
items.why: 政府開始監管 AI 能力評估，代表採購成本上升，廣告科技採購要問供應商安全認證。
items.why_en: Government AI safety testing signals rising compliance costs for enterprise AI — start asking ad-tech vendors about safety certifications before procurement.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: 中國廉價開源 AI 反攻亞洲，ByteDance Doubao 週活 1.55 億超美系工具
items.title_en: China's Cheap Open-Source AI Dominates Asia; ByteDance Doubao Hits 155M Weekly Users
items.summary: CNBC 報道中國 AI 公司以廉價甚至免費開源模型主導亞洲市場，ByteDance Doubao 每週活躍用戶達 1.55 億，遠超美系工具，美國 AI 顧問 David Sacks 警告美國有機會輸掉亞洲 AI 競賽。
items.summary_en: CNBC reports China's AI firms dominate Asia with cheap open-source models. ByteDance Doubao has 155M weekly active users, far ahead of US counterparts. US AI Czar David Sacks warned the US risks losing the Asia AI race.
items.why: 中國品牌用本土 AI 壓低成本，國際品牌要評估能否用 Doubao、Qwen 補充在華投放。
items.why_en: Chinese brands cut ad costs with local AI. International brands in China should evaluate whether Doubao or Qwen can complement in-market campaigns to close the cost gap.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Google Ads 8月17日死線：預算受限廣告系列 tCPA/tROAS 強制執行
items.title_en: Google Ads Aug 17 Deadline: tCPA/tROAS Mandatory for Budget-Constrained Campaigns
items.summary: Google Ads 8月17日起強制執行 tCPA、tROAS 目標，預算受限廣告系列不可再超額表現，部分廣告主 CPA 可能倍增；Google 7月6日已推出「出價目標調整工具」協助過渡。
items.summary_en: From Aug 17, Google Ads mandates tCPA and tROAS targets for budget-constrained campaigns, ending over-delivery. Some advertisers may see CPA double. Google released a bidding-target adjustment tool on July 6 to help transition.
items.why: 8月17日前必查 Search、PMax、Shopping 廣告系列的出價目標設定，避免轉換量突然大跌。
items.why_en: Audit Search, PMax, and Shopping campaign bid-target settings before Aug 17 — failing to act risks a sudden spike in CPA and drop in conversions.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Cloudflare 推出 AEO 能見度儀表板，追蹤品牌喺 ChatGPT、Gemini 的推薦率
items.title_en: Cloudflare Launches AEO Visibility Dashboard to Track Brand Mentions in AI Assistants
items.summary: Cloudflare 推出 AEO（AI 搜尋引擎優化）能見度儀表板，品牌可量度 ChatGPT、Gemini 等 AI 助手有冇推薦自己，追蹤引用率、提及率、顯眼程度、市場聲量佔有率四項指標。
items.summary_en: Cloudflare launched an AEO (AI Engine Optimization) visibility dashboard on Aug 6, letting brands track whether ChatGPT, Gemini, and other AI assistants recommend them, measuring citation rate, mention rate, prominence, and share of voice.
items.why: AI 搜尋正式取代傳統 SEO 嘅部分位置，品牌要開始量度 AI 問答的曝光，唔可以再只看 Google 排名。
items.why_en: AI search is replacing traditional SEO for many brand discovery moments — measuring AI citation share is now as critical as tracking Google rankings.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: The Trade Desk Q2 收入僅升 3%，遠低預期，股價盤後跌逾 21%
items.title_en: The Trade Desk Q2 Revenue Up Just 3%, Far Below Forecast; Stock Drops 21%+ After Hours
items.summary: The Trade Desk Q2 收入 7.15 億美元，僅升 3%；Q3 指引 6.5 億美元遠低市場預期的 8.04 億，CEO Jeff Green 承認執行失誤同宏觀壓力，股價盤後急跌 21% 以上。
items.summary_en: The Trade Desk reported Q2 revenue of $715M, up just 3%, with Q3 guidance of $650M — far below analyst expectations of $804M. CEO Jeff Green cited execution issues and macro headwinds. Stock dropped 21%+ after hours.
items.why: Programmatic DSP 龍頭發出警示，市場增長放緩訊號明確，媒體計劃要考慮加大直接採購比例。
items.why_en: The DSP category leader is flashing a slowdown signal — media plans should reconsider the balance between programmatic and direct buys in the current macro environment.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: WPP H1 收入跌 4.4%，押注 AI 平台 WPP Open 圖 2027 翻身
items.title_en: WPP H1 Revenue Falls 4.4%; Bets AI Platform WPP Open Can Restore Growth by 2027
items.summary: WPP H1 有機收入跌 4.4%，惟 Q2 跌幅已收窄至 2.8%，集團稱 2027 年可重返增長；旗艦 AI 平台 WPP Open 以自動化創意製作及媒體投放為核心，正加速部署。
items.summary_en: WPP's H1 organic revenue fell 4.4%, though Q2 decline narrowed to 2.8%. The group says growth will resume in 2027, anchored by WPP Open — its AI platform automating creative production and media buying.
items.why: 廣告集團大規模轉型 AI 係大勢，代理公司要跟上節奏，效率論述才唔輸蝕。
items.why_en: Major agency networks are all-in on AI automation. Agencies must accelerate their own AI integration to maintain credibility in efficiency conversations with clients.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: EU AI 法案透明度條款 8月2日起生效：AI 廣告素材須清楚標示
items.title_en: EU AI Act Transparency Rules Effective Aug 2: AI-Generated Ad Creatives Must Be Labelled
items.summary: EU AI 法案透明度條款 8月2日正式生效，所有 AI 生成圖片、影片、聲音用於廣告，只要觸達歐盟受眾就須清楚標示；「Deep fake」定義廣，涵蓋大量廣告創意用途。
items.summary_en: EU AI Act transparency provisions took effect Aug 2. All AI-generated images, videos, and audio in ads reaching EU audiences must carry clear labels. The 'deep fake' definition is broad, covering many common ad creative uses.
items.why: 涉及歐盟受眾的品牌廣告要立即建立 AI 內容披露流程，並 brief 創意供應商標籤要求。
items.why_en: Brands reaching EU audiences must immediately establish AI content disclosure workflows and brief creative suppliers on labelling requirements — non-compliance risks ad removal.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: OpenAI ChatGPT 廣告推出 oCPC 計費，programmatic 廣告主正式可入局
items.title_en: OpenAI Turns On oCPC Ads Inside ChatGPT — Programmatic Buyers Can Now Enter
items.summary: OpenAI ChatGPT 廣告平台推出 oCPC（優化每次點擊成本）競投、七天滾動預算、地理排除、AppsFlyer/Adjust 整合，廣告功能愈趨完善，正式進入 performance 媒體競技場。
items.summary_en: OpenAI's ChatGPT ad platform launched oCPC bidding, seven-day rolling budgets, geo-exclusions, and AppsFlyer/Adjust integration — making it a viable performance media channel for programmatic buyers.
items.why: ChatGPT 廣告現支援 oCPC，值得用小預算試水溫，評估 AI 問答場景嘅廣告轉化潛力。
items.why_en: ChatGPT ads now support oCPC — worth testing with a small budget to evaluate conversion potential within AI-assistant search contexts.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Teads 控告 Google 反競爭，Programmatic 生態系法律風險升至最高水位
items.title_en: Teads Sues Google for Antitrust; Programmatic Legal Risk at All-Time High
items.summary: Teads 入稟紐約法院指 Google 綑綁 Google Ads 同 AdX、操控競投（Project Bernanke 從未停用），估計損失 6.88 萬億次廣告曝光；係今年第五家入稟 SSP，歐盟另有 €29.5 億罰款懸而未決。
items.summary_en: Teads sued Google in New York federal court, alleging anti-competitive bundling of Google Ads and AdX and bid manipulation (Project Bernanke still active), claiming loss of 6.88 trillion ad impressions. It is the fifth SSP to sue Google this year.
items.why: Google ad tech 生態法律風險係近年最高，Programmatic 規則可能大變，要密切追蹤裁決進展。
items.why_en: Google ad-tech legal exposure is at its highest ever — any ruling could restructure programmatic rules. Track court developments closely for planning implications.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Omnicom Media Group 香港 MD Helen Cheung 八月底離任
items.title_en: Omnicom Media Group HK Managing Director Helen Cheung Departs End of August
items.summary: Omnicom Media Group 香港董事總經理 Helen Cheung 任期四年後宣布八月底離任，集團積極物色接替人選；本港同期 PHD 及 Hearts & Science 亦有 MD 易人，管理層更替潮持續。
items.summary_en: Omnicom Media Group Hong Kong Managing Director Helen Cheung is departing end of August after four years. The group is actively recruiting her replacement. PHD and Hearts & Science HK have also seen recent MD changes.
items.why: 合作中的 OMG 香港客戶宜主動跟進服務交接安排，確保媒體計劃執行不受影響。
items.why_en: Clients working with OMG HK should proactively confirm service continuity arrangements to ensure media plans are not disrupted during the leadership transition.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 字節跳動 Seedance 2.5 上線即夢 AI 及 CapCut，原生 4K + 30 秒單次生成
items.title_en: ByteDance Seedance 2.5 Live on Jimeng AI & CapCut — Native 4K, 30-Second Single-Shot Video
items.summary: 字節跳動旗艦視頻生成模型 Seedance 2.5 已上線即夢 AI 及豆包專業版，CapCut 亦同步向全球用戶推出，支援 30 秒影片單次生成、最多 50 個多模態參考素材、原生 4K 輸出。
items.summary_en: ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 is live on Jimeng AI, Doubao Pro, and CapCut globally. It supports 30-second single-shot video generation, up to 50 multimodal reference inputs, and native 4K output.
items.why: 廣告影片製作由數天壓縮至分鐘，出中國市場素材效率直接升級，即可測試。
items.why_en: Longer video generation and richer reference inputs dramatically speed up China-market ad creative production — test this in your next campaign brief.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: 可靈 AI 港股 IPO 加速，ARR 年化 US$5 億，騰訊參與跟投
items.title_en: Kling AI Accelerates HK IPO Plans — Annualised ARR $500M, Tencent Joins Round
items.summary: 快手計劃 12 個月內為可靈 AI 完成港交所獨立 IPO，融資目標 30 億美元，估值 180 億美元，ARR 已年化 5 億美元，騰訊亦參與跟投。
items.summary_en: Kuaishou plans to spin off Kling AI for a Hong Kong IPO within 12 months, targeting $3B at an $18B valuation. ARR has hit $500M annualised; Tencent is among the investors.
items.why: 可靈成為獨立商業體，AI 視頻工具競爭加速，廣告素材生成成本料繼續降低。
items.why_en: As an independent entity, Kling will set its own pricing, intensifying AI video competition and likely driving ad creative generation costs lower.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: 美圖 MeituHub 上線：企業 AI 影像生產線，批量產出千張成品圖
items.title_en: Meitu's MeituHub Launches: Enterprise AI Image Pipeline Producing Thousands of Assets
items.summary: 美圖 8月5日正式上線 MeituHub，用自然語言搭建企業視覺工作流，批量產出數百至千張成品圖，主打電商及市場推廣高頻場景。
items.summary_en: Meitu officially launched MeituHub on August 5, enabling enterprises to build visual workflows via natural language, producing hundreds to thousands of finished images per run — targeting e-commerce and marketing production at scale.
items.why: 廣告素材批量製作成本大降，多 SKU 落地圖快速規模化，值得評估接入現有流程。
items.why_en: Batch brand visual production is now significantly cheaper — worth evaluating whether MeituHub can plug into your existing creative workflow for multi-SKU campaigns.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: Runway 推出首個 AI 媒體模型路由器：按成本/速度/品質自動分流
items.title_en: Runway Launches First AI Media Router — Auto-Routes by Cost, Speed, or Quality
items.summary: Runway 推出 Media Router，讓開發者毋須手動揀模型，系統按成本、速度、品質自動分流，橫跨影片、圖像、音頻，同時支援 Seedance、Google Gemini、OpenAI 等第三方模型。
items.summary_en: Runway's Media Router automatically routes generative media tasks across models based on cost, latency, or quality — covering video, image, and audio, with support for ByteDance Seedance, Google Gemini, and OpenAI.
items.why: 代理公司可用一個 API 整合多家模型，按需自動切換，大幅壓低生成式素材成本。
items.why_en: Agencies can use a single API to tap multiple top-tier models and auto-route by project requirements — cutting the cost of AI-generated ad creatives at scale.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: Canva 7月更新：AI Post Writer 自動寫 Caption，Canva Code 2.0 全面開放
items.title_en: Canva July Update: AI Post Writer Auto-Generates Captions; Canva Code 2.0 Goes Live
items.summary: Canva 7月上線 AI Post Writer（設計完成即自動生成社媒文案）及 Canva Code 2.0（全用戶開放可視化 AI 寫碼），同時支援 Brand Kit 儲存影片素材，一鍵發布品牌模板。
items.summary_en: Canva's July update brings AI Post Writer (auto-generates social captions from finished designs), Canva Code 2.0 for all users, video storage in Brand Kits, and one-click brand template publishing.
items.why: 做 XHS、WeChat 素材的同事可直接用 AI Post Writer 省去配文時間，品牌模板統一分發亦減少版本控制問題。
items.why_en: Teams producing XHS and WeChat creatives can cut caption-writing time with AI Post Writer; centralized brand template publishing reduces version control errors.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: 小紅書 2026 算法升級：購買意圖內容加權，過度商業化帖子受懲
items.title_en: XHS 2026 Algorithm: Purchase-Intent Content Boosted; Overly Promotional Posts Penalised
items.summary: 小紅書 2026 年算法三大升級：AI 個人化提升、整合電商排序訊號（購買意圖內容加權）、跨平台行為識別，同時加強打壓過度推銷性內容，原創度加權更顯著。
items.summary_en: XHS 2026 algorithm has three major upgrades: enhanced AI personalization, integrated commerce signals (purchase-intent content ranked higher), and cross-platform behaviour recognition. Overly promotional content is penalised; originality rewarded.
items.why: KOC 水下筆記要更貼近「真實分享」語氣，過度推廣感反而減少曝光，品牌 brief 要同步調整。
items.why_en: KOC seeding notes must feel like genuine sharing — an overtly promotional tone now reduces organic distribution. Brand briefs need updating immediately.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: 中國 AI 生成內容強制標籤規定：品牌廣告合規義務持續
items.title_en: China AI Content Mandatory Labelling: Ongoing Compliance Obligation for Brand Ads
items.summary: 中國要求所有 AI 生成內容（文字、圖像、音頻、影片）加可見與隱藏雙層標籤，自 2025年9月起實施，直接影響品牌在小紅書、抖音等平台的 AI 廣告素材合規要求。
items.summary_en: China requires visible and hidden dual labelling on all AI-generated content including text, images, audio, and video, effective September 2025. This directly impacts brand AI creative compliance on XHS, Douyin, and WeChat.
items.why: 用 AI 做中國廣告素材要確保標籤合規，違規面臨平台下架，需 brief 創意供應商。
items.why_en: Brands using AI creatives in China must ensure compliance with labelling rules — include this requirement in all creative supplier briefs to avoid platform removal.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Meta Advantage+ 升級 Brand Memory：廣告回報 4.13 倍，學習品牌廣告庫風格
items.title_en: Meta Advantage+ Upgrades Brand Memory — $4.13 Return Per $1, Learns from Ad Library
items.summary: Meta 在 Cannes Lions 宣布 Advantage+ 全面升級，旗艦功能「Brand Memory」學習品牌現有廣告庫風格並自動生成貼牌廣告；同步推出圖像轉影片廣告同 11 語言 AI 配音，平台報告廣告投資回報達 4.13 倍。
items.summary_en: Meta announced Advantage+ upgrades at Cannes Lions, with Brand Memory learning from existing ad libraries to auto-generate on-brand creatives. New features include image-to-video ads and 11-language AI dubbing. Platform reports $4.13 ROAS.
items.why: 國際品牌落中國市場廣告同時要跑 Meta，Brand Memory 令多語言素材製作大提速，值得立即測試。
items.why_en: International brands running both Meta and China market campaigns can use Brand Memory to speed up localized multilingual creative production — worth testing now.

items.title: Reddit Q2 廣告收入升 64%，連續八季高增長，廣告主數量增七成
items.title_en: Reddit Q2 Ad Revenue Up 64% — Eight Consecutive Quarters of High Growth, Advertisers Up 70%
items.summary: Reddit Q2 廣告收入達 7.62 億美元，升 64%，廣告主數量增七成以上，日活 1.303 億，係全球增速第二快廣告平台，以高意圖社群受眾著稱。
items.summary_en: Reddit Q2 ad revenue hit $762M, up 64%, with advertiser count growing over 70% and daily active users at 130.3M. It's the second fastest-growing ad platform globally, known for high-intent community audiences.
items.why: 高意圖受眾、低競爭，國際品牌進入中國前先在 Reddit 建立社群品牌聲量係高效選擇。
items.why_en: High-intent audiences with lower competition than Meta — international brands should consider Reddit for community-driven brand building ahead of China market entry.

items.title: 微信智能托管廣告全面開放+暑期小遊戲激勵，新廣告主可享歷史最高返點
items.title_en: WeChat Intelligent Ad Management Open to All + Summer Mini Game Incentives at Record Rebates
items.summary: 微信 6月1日起向全體短劇 Mini Program 廣告主開放「智能托管」能力，結合暑期小遊戲廣告專項激勵，新廣告主可獲歷史最高返點，微信生態廣告 AI 程度大幅躍升。
items.summary_en: WeChat opened intelligent ad management to all short-drama Mini Program advertisers from June 1. Combined with a summer Mini Game incentive offering record-high rebates for new advertisers, WeChat's AI automation has reached a new level.
items.why: 做微信廣告此時入局小遊戲，可疊加最高返點加智能托管，同時降成本提效率。
items.why_en: WeChat advertisers running summer campaigns can stack maximum rebates with intelligent management — a rare window to cut costs while improving campaign efficiency simultaneously.

items.title: CapCut + Seedance 2.5 實戰：產品圖到廣告影片五分鐘搞掂
items.title_en: CapCut + Seedance 2.5 Walkthrough: From Product Image to Ad Video in Five Minutes
items.summary: CapCut 全球訂閱用戶現可用 Seedance 2.5，配合 Script to Video 及 AI Fashion Video Maker，產品圖加文字 brief 即可直接輸出 4K 廣告影片，電商廣告素材製作完全自動化。
items.summary_en: CapCut global subscribers can now access Seedance 2.5 alongside Script to Video and AI Fashion Video Maker — go from a product image and text brief to a 4K ad video, with e-commerce creative production fully automated.
items.why: KV 影片由數天壓縮至數分鐘，中小品牌同代理公司今日就可以試，一個月 brief 週期將會縮短。
items.why_en: KV video production compressed from days to minutes — test it today; a one-month campaign brief cycle can now be cut to a fraction of that time.

items.title: AEO 新玩法：用 Cloudflare 儀表板三步追蹤品牌喺 AI 問答的可見度
items.title_en: New AEO Play: Three Steps to Track Brand Visibility in AI Assistants Using Cloudflare
items.summary: Cloudflare AEO 儀表板免費開放，追蹤品牌喺 ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity 等 AI 助手的推薦表現：設置品牌關鍵詞→追蹤四大指標（引用率、提及率、顯眼程度、聲量佔有率）→對比競品差距。
items.summary_en: Cloudflare's AEO Dashboard is free to set up: configure brand keywords → track four metrics (citation rate, mention rate, prominence, share of voice) → benchmark against competitors across ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity.
items.why: AI 搜尋已係消費者問問題首選，不量度 AI 可見度等同忽視快速增長的發現渠道。
items.why_en: AI assistants are the first stop for consumer queries — not measuring AI visibility means flying blind on a rapidly growing discovery channel.
items.section: 即學技巧 & 玩法

items.title: Runway Gen-3 Alpha Turbo 及 Gen-4 Aleph 已停用，API 用戶限今立即遷移
items.title_en: Runway Gen-3 Alpha Turbo and Gen-4 Aleph Deprecated — API Users Must Migrate Now
items.summary: Runway 7月30日起正式停用 Gen-3 Alpha Turbo 及 Gen-4 Aleph API，現推薦旗艦版 Gen-4.5；最快速版本為 Gen-4 Turbo；已用 Gen-4 Aleph 者自動遷至 Aleph 2.0，舊 API Call 會失效。
items.summary_en: Runway deprecated Gen-3 Alpha Turbo and Gen-4 Aleph from its API on July 30. Gen-4.5 is the new flagship; Gen-4 Turbo is the fastest option. Gen-4 Aleph users are auto-migrated to Aleph 2.0, but old API calls will fail.
items.why: 現有用 Runway API 做廣告素材的工作流要立即確認模型版本，避免 API Call 失效影響生產排期。
items.why_en: Any workflow using the Runway API for ad creative production must verify model versions immediately to prevent production disruption from deprecated endpoints.

items.title: XHS 水下筆記應對 2026 算法：購買意圖寫法同真實分享語氣平衡術
items.title_en: XHS Seeding Notes for 2026 Algorithm: Balancing Purchase Intent with Authentic Voice
items.summary: 小紅書 2026 算法加權購買意圖同原創度，新玩法：用真實場景埋入購買動機，避免硬推廣開頭，標籤不超過 5 個，錯峰發布，互動率係關鍵訊號。
items.summary_en: XHS 2026 rewards purchase intent and originality. Updated seeding playbook: embed purchase motivation in genuine usage scenes (e.g. 'tried it last night and only then realized…'), avoid promotional openers, cap tags at 5, stagger publish times — engagement rate is the key ranking signal.
items.why: 品牌 brief KOC 時要明確給「真實場景框架」而唔係產品賣點清單，話少啲廣告話多啲體驗。
items.why_en: When briefing KOCs, give them a 'genuine scenario framework' rather than a product feature list — fewer claims, more authentic experience narratives.
items.section: 即學技巧 & 玩法
